name: Logo draws from a point
looks: On a near-black field, a single accent dot sits alone, then a thick geometric stroke draws outward from it into an arrow shape; the arrow completes and the wordmark types in beside it in a heavy grotesk. A hard cut flashes the last word alone, oversized, on a flat accent-colour card with a faint ghost watermark of itself behind it.
build: SVG path draw-on for the arrow stroke (strokeDashoffset to 0 on power2.out, ~0.6s), the dot holding as a static anchor at the stroke's start point with a soft radial glow. Wordmark letters fade/rise in as one block once the stroke lands, not letter by letter. Hard cut (no cross-fade) into the single-word card; the ghost watermark is the same glyph at 8-10% opacity, scaled up and offset.
sound: A soft low swell under the draw, a single clean hit on the stroke's completion, a sharper hit on the hard cut to the word card.
prompt: Open on a lone accent dot in a dark field, then draw a simple geometric mark outward from it in one continuous stroke; once it lands, type the wordmark in beside it. Hard-cut to a flat accent-colour card holding just the brand's own word, oversized, with a faint ghost echo of itself behind it.
